item.tib: zhi khro bder gshegs 'dus pa'i rgyud las gsang sgrubs tso dmar 'khyil ba
item.coloph: khro rgyal bder gshegs 'dus pa zhes bya ba/ dbal bon stag la me 'bar gyi brnag pa/ bla chen dran pa'i thugs bcud/ stang chen dmu tsa'i bsnyan (tshas snyan) du brgyud/ dus mtha'i rnal 'byor bdag gis spyod yul/ gsang ba sngags kyi spyi sgrabs (sgrab) zhes bya ba/ stang chen dmu tsha gyer med kyis/ dus mtha'i rnal 'byor mi shig ming / dad ldan bdag la snyan du brgyud ste(de/)dkar chab (chag) yi ger bris pa 'di/ yi dam zhi khro rnams la mthol lo bshags/ bka' skyong bstan srung rnams la bzod par gsol/ dge ba (bas)'gro kun bla med sa thob shogs (shog)/
